lessons.title: Add by bridging a multiple of ten

misconceptions.text: Children think the multiple of ten before 43 is 30, or write 40 - 2 = 48, forgetting the previous ten
Children count in ones instead of adding tens, and partition the second addend inefficiently
Children confuse whether to add or take away when a bar model or word problem is used
